description: 基础实验 A-F 的确定性事实核验和人工审核规则。

items.evidence: Student author registration fee is USD 350.
items.response_guidance: Confirm the student author registration fee as USD 350.

items.evidence: Full paper submission deadline is February 15, 2027.
items.response_guidance: State the full paper submission deadline as February 15, 2027.

items.evidence: Personal acceptance results can only be checked through the submission system and must not be disclosed in email.
items.review_reason: Personal paper acceptance decisions must not be disclosed by email and require human handling.
items.response_guidance: Do not state an acceptance result. Direct the sender to the submission system and use the human-review marker.

items.evidence: The fact card contains no verified payment record and the sender's payment claim is unverified.
items.review_reason: Payment receipt status cannot be verified from the fact card and requires human review.
items.response_guidance: Do not confirm payment receipt. State that the payment record requires review by the conference secretariat.

items.evidence: No invoice policy or invoice handling procedure is provided in the fact card.
items.review_reason: The invoice request requires human review because no invoice policy is provided.
items.response_guidance: Do not promise an invoice. State that the request requires review by the conference secretariat.

items.evidence: Accommodation information has not yet been announced.
items.response_guidance: Do not recommend a hotel. State that accommodation information has not yet been announced.

items.evidence: No airport transportation information is provided in the fact card.
items.response_guidance: Do not provide invented transportation details. Refer the sender to the conference secretariat or official announcements.

items.evidence: No formal refund policy is provided, and refunds must be confirmed by staff.
items.review_reason: Refund eligibility must be reviewed manually because no formal refund policy is provided.
items.response_guidance: Do not promise a full refund. State that the request requires review by the conference secretariat.

items.evidence: No refund processing timeline is provided in the fact card.
items.review_reason: No refund processing timeline is available and the case requires human review.
items.response_guidance: Do not provide a processing time. State that the request requires review by the conference secretariat.

items.evidence: No submission-system policy is needed to request diagnostic information about the upload failure.
items.response_guidance: Ask for an error screenshot, submission ID if available, browser and version, operating system, file format and size, the exact error message, and the time the issue occurred.
